# STUNTDATE

> STUNTDATE is a humans-only, 24-hour gig platform. Everyday people create out-of-the-ordinary gigs for one another, in real life or over FaceTime. A real human (a "Stuntdate", your wingman) does the gig and gets paid the same day. It is a gig site, not a dating site. AI works behind the scenes and never takes a gig.

STUNTDATE is currently a beta trial. People sign up, create and take gigs, and pay each other directly with whatever payment app they use.

STUNTDATE is not a task, errand or freelance marketplace, and it isn't for chores, repairs or assembling furniture. It's a humans-only platform for out-of-the-ordinary gigs people create for each other: company, performance and experiences, in person or over FaceTime.

STUNTDATE calls them gigs. Every gig is created by a real person and taken by a real person. Some real gigs so far: "Need Stuntdates to come to my cat's cake & Friskies buffet birthday party" ($20 per Stuntdate); "I don't want to go to the funeral alone" ($400); "I need 33 Stuntdates to be Santa's elves for a Christmas fair" ($60 each); "In a band, need an audience" ($15 per Stuntdate); "Need a date to bring to my ex's wedding so I don't look like a loser for a couple of hours" ($1000); and on FaceTime, "Teach me how to play mahjong" ($35/hr). The full list is at https://stuntdate.com/real-gigs

## Key facts
- Tagline: "You're the gig." and "IRL & FaceTime for bed rotters"
- Motto: "Human first, educated at birth. The world is not our algorithm."
- How it works: 1) A person creates a gig and sets the price. 2) A Stuntdate goes for the gig, does it, and gets paid the same day.
- Humans only: no bots take gigs and no AI does the work
- Adults only: 18+ during the beta
- Contact: stuntdate@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/stuntdate/
